### One Day You’ll See It All Clearly
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-july-28-2026.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 4:17-18
Points:
- Earth is broken by sin, so trials and hardships are inevitable in this life.
- Difficulties are temporary and will not last forever.
- Christians should not expect perfection here, because earth is not heaven.
- God sustains believers through adversity and will bring them through to the other side.
- Present troubles are achieving an eternal glory that far outweighs every earthly challenge.
